messages:
alex k: Kickoff — PRD + scope for smart routing / fallback policy. Customer asks (Acme, FinCorp) for region-aware failover + deterministic variant compatibility. Need acceptance criteria, edge cases, and owners. Who can take the lead?

maria g: I can own the PRD draft and checklist. @kevin r want to pair on acceptance criteria? :calendar:

kevin r: propose phases to limit scope: 1) Tiered routing + simple same-family fallback (verified variants only). 2) Region failover with compatibility matrix and QA. 3) Cross-tier/cost-aware fallback. Phase 1 prototype in ~2w, canary 4w, GA in 6-7w.

sophia p: We need explicit SLA metrics in the PRD: failover decision latency <200ms, end-to-end success rate >=99.95% under normal load, no cross-region data leaks. Also add rollback/runbook requirements.

alex k: Acceptance criteria (initial):
- deterministic mapping rules for routing and fallback
- unit tests for mapping logic + compatibility checks
- e2e test harness with fault injection (region down, high latency, OOM)
- docs + runbook + canary plan
Thoughts?

maria g: Add compatibility matrix (tokenizer, kv-cache shape, quantization class). Block fallbacks if kv-cache shapes are incompatible or if oplist differs.

kevin r: Example policy snippet to illustrate config we expect in PRD:
```
policy:
  tiers: [premium, standard, best-effort]
  fallback_order:
    premium: [premium, standard]
    standard: [standard, best-effort]
  region_policy:
    prefer_same_region: true
    cross_region_grace_ms: 250
  variant_compatibility:
    enforce_family: true
    allow_quant_diff: false
```

sophia p: Edge cases to capture in acceptance tests: partial kv-cache mismatch (trim vs pad), quantized vs float model path causing subtle output drift, region with read-only model artifacts during rollout, and model version pinning collisions.

alex k: Scope negotiation note: drop auto-quantized fallback for phase 1. Phase1 will only allow fallbacks between pre-verified variants (same family + verified profile). Auto-quantization, dynamic re-quant fallback, and cross-architecture fallbacks deferred to phase 2/3.

julian (product): From customers: Acme needs sticky region fallback due to GDPR constraints (stay in EU unless failover forced). We need per-customer flags: prefer_region, allow_cross_region_fallback, audit_logging. Also record reason codes for fallback decisions.

maria g: I created a PRD skeleton in docs (link: https://internal.redwood/docs/prd/smart-routing-fallback/1812345123-draft). Added initial checklist and sections: goals, non-goals, acceptance criteria, test plan, rollout. @kevin r can you add the compatibility test matrix?

kevin r: Will do. For canary we should reserve capacity: 5% traffic in target region, run 48h observability window (latency, error-rate, output-drift). If any regression >1% or latency increase >20% we roll back.

deploy-bot: PRD page created: /docs/prd/smart-routing-fallback/1812345123-draft.md

alex k: Decision recap: Phase1 = tiered routing + verified same-family fallback + per-customer fallback flags + audit logs + runbook. Owners: maria g (PRD & docs), kevin r (implementation & tests), sophia p (SLA, QA & canary).

maria g: Acknowledged. I'll open RFC with detailed acceptance criteria and link the test plan.

kevin r: Timeline: prototype 2w, canary 4w, GA 6-7w assuming infra capacity and no major regressions. I'll post the compatibility test harness repo link once ready.

alex k: Blockers? infra quotas, model verification backlog? @eng-infra please advise on capacity reservations for canary.

maria g: Noted infra ask. I'll add capacity request to the PRD and tag infra.

alex k: Thanks team :thumbsup: Let's try to keep PRD concise and decision-focused so sales/AE can share with Acme.

kevin r: Quick note — include a short appendix listing unacceptable fallback outcomes (silent output drift, increased hallucinations) so quality team has a clear veto.

sophia p: Good call. I'll draft a regression threshold table (latency, perplexity delta, hallucination indicators).

alex k: Great. Closing this kickoff thread — next step: maria to open RFC and mention canary dates.

maria g: RFC opened and tagged reviewers. Thanks all.
